maya.ram: quick report 1 tao-v2-q8 onboarding: bracket/parens mirror flips when Arabic or Hebrew contains embedded CJK. BLEU for ar-IL/he-IL down ~7 pts vs fp16.
liang.wu: paste a minimal repro pls
maya.ram: input (ar): "4227442a 274434314329 (\u6771eac) 2346 274445284a39272a 28443a2a 2,500 2f48442731."
fp16 -> "... (\u6771\u4eac) ... 2,500 \u062f\u0648\u0644\u0627\u0631."
q8 -> "... )\u6771\u4eac( ... 2,500 \u062f\u0648\u0644\u0627\u0631."  (parentheses reversed)
omar.ahmed: classic bidi detok issue but weird it's q8-only
jana.eval: token diff shows fp16 keeps '(' and CJK as separate tokens; q8 fused them into one token ")\u6771\u4eac(" — detok then applies mirror lookup and flips.
ci-bot: nightly-eval 4321000200: BLEU_fp16(ar-IL)=31.0 BLEU_q8(ar-IL)=24.2 BLEU_fp16(he-IL)=30.1 BLEU_q8(he-IL)=23.1 mean_len_fp16=19.8 mean_len_q8=19.0
liang.wu: check kernel selection/logs. any change?
maya.ram: yes int8 path used aten_mm_small_int8_v3; fuse pass "paren_span_fuse" appears only in int8 transform graph.
omar.ahmed: two hypotheses: (A) quantized logits rounding pushes decode to emit a different subword boundary; (B) a graph pass erroneously fuses paired-punct+adjacent-CJK into one token.
jana.eval: tried beam_size=6 vs greedy: beam helps (BLEU_q8->25.8) but doesn't close gap. toggling runtime detok flag to legacy reduces errors (BLEU->27.1).
liang.wu: action items: 1) tokenizer-only pass (no model) on failing strings to confirm tokenizer artifact; 2) dump token ids + byte offsets for fused spans; 3) reproduce locally with the exact q8 weights single-threaded; 4) add synthetic RTL+CJK punctuation suite to nightly.
maya.ram: I'll add 150 synthetic cases (ar/he w/ ja/zh + numerals/punct). opening PR.
omar.ahmed: I'll try disabling paren_span_fuse and rerun local int8 smoke. also will diff logits around boundaries to see quant rounding effect.
jana.eval: wiring the synthetic suite into regression, setting alert if paired-punct mirror errors > 0.5%.
liang.wu: medium-term: modify detok to use Unicode Bidi_Class canonical mirror mapping rather than relying on token span orientation; add locale-aware heuristics.
ci-bot: issue REDWOOD-ML-1311 created and attached examples.
maya.ram: thanks, will post reproduction results here. :eyes:
